name: CODEX-b
full_name: COmpact Detector for EXotics at LHCb
summary: CODEX-b is proposed in shielded underground space near LHCb at CERN LHC Point 8, as a long-lived dark-sector particle program.
detection_principle: Tracks in shielded space next to LHCb reconstruct vertices of long-lived particles decaying to charged particles; a prototype measures backgrounds and validates the detection concept.

key_parameters.value: Prototype linear scale approximately one fifth of the full design; subject to the final technical design

results.summary: Initial prototype data validate the design and backgrounds in the real LHC environment; they are not full-experiment dark-matter physics results.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
